RobotHead.js is adapted from the published robot-heads 0.3.0 ESM renderer by Fayaz Ahmed, MIT licensed. The license is preserved in ../robot-heads.LICENSE.txt.

Original dist/index.js SHA-256: be4b06c688a61aeb52b2b8e12a6f981e4ade186790e4f258dc9ef48b19743555

The attached prop constrains the rendered pose through attachedHeadPose so a full-body avatar keeps its head at its neck while preserving LED expressions and antenna animation. Other rendering logic is unchanged. The npm dependency remains available for the original head-only mode.
